info.name: Checkout and Rewards — Complete Customer Walkthrough
info.description: Run all folders in order with Collection Runner, one iteration. Creates a customer, dedicated product, six successful orders and a coupon redemption under the default n=5 policy. IDs and keys are captured automatically. Includes an expected empty-cart 409, exact replay, admin recovery 409 and read-only report reconciliation. Existing orders are accounted for by a baseline; use a server with no concurrent writers and no manually deleted milestone coupons. Policies with n>5 may not earn a coupon in this run; sixth checkout then proceeds without one. Each run changes database state. No authentication is configured.
